test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Reveal
solution:
The correct answer is **Disclose.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word is Disclose.
 
• Reveal means making public to others previously unknown or secret knowledge.
 
• Thus the correct answer is Disclose.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The synonyms of the word **Reveal **are **divulged,** **disclose, tell** etc.
 
• The antonyms of the word** Reveal** are-** hide,** **conceal etc.**
 
• **A curb **means a **constraint or checks on something**.
 
• **Darken **means **making something dark or darker.**
 
• **A veil **means a** fine piece of fabric worn by women to protect or conceal the face.**
